title: Ear-EEG Sleep Monitoring 2023 (EESM23)
description: This dataset comprises overnight ear-EEG recordings from 10 healthy participants, collected between 2020 and 2022 as part of a study on ear-EEG based sleep monitoring. The first two recordings include simultaneous polysomnography (PSG) and ear-EEG measurements, while subsequent nights consist solely of ear-EEG recordings performed at the subjects' homes. The dataset is intended to support development and validation of ear-EEG as a wearable alternative to traditional PSG for sleep staging and monitoring.
methods_description: Recordings were made overnight at participants' homes using ear-EEG equipment, with the first two sessions also including polysomnography. Each recording session included a pre-sleep 'video' task followed by a 'sleep' task, with subjects manually marking events (e.g., bedtime, lights-out) using a trigger button. Data were converted to BIDS format using the EEGLAB '.set' file format.
